title: What If You Raced a Horse for 22 Miles? Humans Have Won

scenes.text: What if you raced a horse for 22 miles? A human has actually won.
It's the Man versus Horse Marathon in Wales, started in 1980 after an argument in a pub.
The route is hilly farm tracks, forests and open moorland. For 24 years, no runner beat a horse.
In 2004, Huw Lobb finished in two hours, five minutes and 19 seconds, and won twenty-five thousand pounds.
In 2007, Florian Holzinger won by 11 minutes. Runners have won again in 2022, 2023 and 2025.
Horses are faster on flat ground, but on the right hilly day, a person can win. Which side would you bet on?
